lede: (the five verified Sugarplay plates, re-dressed. a sweet-shop counter, a screenplay page, conversation hearts, a chalk hopscotch, a paper fortune teller. every figure is the listing's.)
idea: Sugarplay's plates were always the best-natured pictures in the archive, and their first overlays treated them like catalogue pages. This pass lets each picture keep playing: the price stickers on the jellies are sweet-shop stickers, the Paris hoop becomes an overheard screenplay, the Heartbead gets conversation hearts stamped with its own spec, the hopscotch squares six, seven and eight are the ring's real sizes, and the origami fortune teller has a listing fact under every flap.
type: Velista headline with the second word in oxblood, auto-fitted to the column. Then the device: a candy-stripe band with four round stickers in Jost; a JetBrains Mono screenplay with a scene slug and centred character names; four SVG hearts in two blush tones with mono text inside; a dashed chalk hopscotch with the three live sizes filled solid; a four-flap fortune teller in SVG with dashed folds. Blush-tinted ground throughout.
review: Verification: pl02, pl03 and pl06 checked at full resolution against the listing photographs (cushion pastel stones in pavé halos with a fold-over clasp; the plait on the ear with no stones; mirror steel spheres with a gold toggle and one gold heart). pl04 and pl05 are the volume's re-shot plates and were verified in that pass; pl08 Marbles was passed over because its signature drop pearl does not read. Pass 1: the hearts rendered behind the card and vanished; two headlines clipped; the screenplay overran the foot. Pass 2: hearts brought forward and re-toned, headlines auto-fitted, the screenplay card given a shorter plate.
verdict: run Pick 'n' Mix and The Big Call at spend; Hopscotch and the Fortune Teller sit on four-unit pieces and belong in organic.

S1.title: PICK 'N' MIX.
S1.why: The rivière on sugared jellies with a candy-stripe counter band and four price stickers: 5mm, ×3 colours, pavé, ₹2,399 the lot.
S1.check: 5mm cushion stones and the 15–19cm range on B00681C; 77 units; waterproof.

S2.title: THE BIG CALL.
S2.why: The hoop on the phone in Paris, so the card is the call: a screenplay page where HER says twenty-five millimetres, a braid, no stones, and that's the whole call.
S2.check: 25mm and no stones on E20267O; 77 units.

S3.title: SWEETHEART.
S3.why: The Heartbead on coral with four conversation hearts, each stamped with something from the listing instead of a sweet nothing.
S3.check: 6mm spheres, gold toggle and one gold heart on YF5215; 29 units.

S4.title: HOP TO YOUR SIZE.
S4.why: Rings on a chalk hopscotch. The squares 6, 7 and 8 are filled solid because those are the ring's sizes; it is open-backed and adjusts between them.
S4.source: Sugarplay plate 04, the volume's re-shot Petite Pavé.
S4.check: US 6 to 8 adjustable, four bands, two pavé and two plain on WR12518B; 4 units, non-hero card.

S5.title: PICK A NUMBER.
S5.why: Bow studs on an origami fortune teller; the card draws the fortune teller and prints a listing fact under every flap. Pick any number, it is all true.
S5.check: 15mm wide, pear-cut CZ in gold claws on E16075B; 4 units, non-hero card.
